answer: The timber schedule is applied in plume and whisper publishes each instalment. A payout is split thus 57% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Someone thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1705 identities would post 696 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
